name: breathing-montage
title_zh: 把高密度剪辑钉在呼吸节奏上的帧级语法
tagline_zh: 15–120 秒短片，快切不窒息、闪白不刺眼。给每个 2–6 帧插入设计好呼吸点，让 AI 生成的画面也有剪辑师的。
tagline_en: For 15–120s shorts: fast cuts that breathe, strobes that don't sting. Frame-level rhythm skeleton for.
desc_en: Style-agnostic grammar for high-density editing with breathing room ("呼吸式高密度剪辑") — a frame-level rhythm skeleton for 15–120s short films, plus the AI-production discipline to execute it with image/video generation models. Use whenever the user wants: high-density or fast-cut editing that still breathes; a strobe/flash climax sequence; subliminal insert design (2–6 frame cuts); a two-worlds opposit
why_zh: 它不教风格，只给节奏骨架——把「呼吸感」变成可计算的帧间距规则，让高密度剪辑在 AI 生成流程里也能稳。
why_en: Style-agnostic by design: it turns 'breathing room' into a frame-distance grammar, so high-density pacing survives AI generation.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 15–120 秒短片；需要你已有图像/视频生成模型的调用能力，它给的是节奏骨架和剪辑纪律，不生成任何画面。
limit_en: Only for 15–120s shorts; requires your own image/video gen model access. It provides rhythm skeleton & discipline, not footage. Outside this range.
